purpose: Observed wet/dry calls for races with no official series condition report, where the reanalysis call was disputed: every race the reanalysis calls wet, and the two where it disagreed with the older INDY NXT single-hour backfill. An observed call outranks the reanalysis; an official series report outranks both. Station observations are NOAA GHCNh (UTC); extracts in data/career/raw/weather/noaa-ghcnh/ (MANIFEST.json gives each by-year source and its sha256).

calls.summary: Dry. Detroit City airport (KDET, 9 km) reports rain overnight that ended by 10:00 UTC (06:00 local), mist to 12:53 UTC, then 0.0 mm and no present weather at 13:53, 14:53 and 15:53 UTC, bracketing the 14:20-15:16 UTC race; rain returns only at 16:53 UTC. No race report mentions a wet track; Bryce describes oversteer into the Turn 7 wall.

Dry. Mansfield Lahm airport (KMFD, 18 km) reports no precipitation and no present weather from a thunderstorm in the vicinity at 19:20 UTC on July 4 through the 14:08-14:44 UTC race, with 16 km visibility all morning. The reanalysis's 2.8 mm in the hour before the start is not observed. The race ran all-green (Andretti Global; INDYCAR: 'went ahead without interruption').

Mixed. Dry at the start: Eagle Creek (KEYE, 6 km) and Indianapolis International (KIND, 10 km) report no present weather to 19:54 UTC, then light rain at 20:53-20:54 UTC, inside the 20:00-20:55 UTC race window, and moderate rain by 21:53. The season record says the race was halted when it started to rain and every driver switched to wet tyres.

Dry. St. Louis Downtown airport (KCPS, 10 km) reports no precipitation and no present weather, with 16 km visibility, from 18:53 to 23:15 UTC, covering the 21:35-22:18 UTC race. Bryce retired on lap 5 (mechanical).
